step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a programmable current source designed to charge a capacitor and generate a precise voltage ramp. It consists of a wide-swing cascode current mirror biased by a self-biased beta-multiplier reference. The reference current is programmed by an NMOS transistor (XM1) operating in the linear region, whose resistance is controlled by VCTRL.

paper_reference.title: On-Chip Ramp Generators for Mixed-Signal BIST and ADC Self-Test

DC_Current.description: DC output current of the ramp generator at a given control voltage (VCTRL=0.9V).

sky130_expected.calculation: With VCTRL=0.9V, XM1 acts as a resistor R ~ 1 / (u_n*C_ox * W/L * (Vgs-Vth)) ~ 770 ohms. The beta-multiplier current is I = (Vgs5 - Vgs2)/R. Assuming W2/W5 = 4, I is approximately 300 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact threshold voltage and mobility of the SKY130 NMOS devices.

Ramp_Slope.description: Voltage ramp rate (dV/dt) across a 10pF load capacitor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the DC charging current and inversely proportional to the load capacitance.

Slope_Error.description: Percentage difference between the actual transient slope and the ideal slope calculated from DC current and capacitance (I/C).

sky130_expected.reasoning: The finite output impedance of the cascode current source causes a slight deviation from the ideal constant-current charging.

INL_Midpoint.description: Integral Non-Linearity measured at the midpoint of the 10% to 90% ramp range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Deviation of the actual voltage from the ideal straight line at the time midpoint between 10% and 90% VDD (ideal is exactly 0.9V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The high output impedance of the wide-swing cascode keeps the current very constant, resulting in extremely low INL, matching the paper's microvolt-level claims.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC charging current, transient ramp slope, slope error, and midpoint INL of the ramp generator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Ramp Generator
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=0.5u $ Modified from 5u to 20u to enable beta-multiplier operation
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N5 VCTRL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N3 N4 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 IOUT N1 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N6 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 N1 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N9 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Connect N4 and N5 to form the beta-multiplier source degeneration
Vshort N4 N5 0

* Power supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVCTRL VCTRL 0 0.9

* Load and measurement
Vmeas_I IOUT IOUT_meas 0
Cload IOUT_meas 0 10p

* Reset switch to hold IOUT at 0V initially
Vreset reset 0 PWL(0 1.8 10n 1.8 11n 0)
Mreset IOUT_meas reset 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.15u W=10u

* Startup nodeset for the self-biased loop
.nodeset v(N3)=1.0 v(N0)=0.5 v(N1)=0.5

.control
  * Run transient analysis
  tran 0.1n 500n
  
  * Measure DC current before reset is released (at t=5ns)
  meas tran i_out_dc find i(Vmeas_I) at=5n
  
  * Measure ramp times for 10% (0.18V) and 90% (1.62V) of VDD
  meas tran t_10 trig v(IOUT_meas) val=0.18 rise=1
  meas tran t_90 trig v(IOUT_meas) val=1.62 rise=1
  
  * Calculate actual slope (V/s and V/us)
  let slope = (1.62 - 0.18) / (t_90 - t_10)
  let slope_vus = slope / 1e6
  
  * Calculate slope error compared to ideal I/C
  let ideal_slope = i_out_dc / 10e-12
  let slope_error_pct = (slope - ideal_slope) / ideal_slope * 100
  
  * Calculate INL at the midpoint of the ramp
  let t_mid = (t_10 + t_90) / 2
  meas tran v_mid find v(IOUT_meas) at=t_mid
  let inl = v_mid - 0.9
  
  * Print all metrics
  print i_out_dc slope_vus slope_error_pct inl
  
  quit
.endc
